exposure: expectant management of preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) according to new recommendations
cohort: 2017 women with LPT births (between 34 0/7 and 36 6/7 weeks gestation) at a Swiss center between January 1, 2002 and December 31, 2012
finding: Adoption of new guidelines for the management of PPROM could potentially prevent a considerable number of LPT births.
mod_finding: The rate of LPT births that could have been avoided varied depending on the scenario used, with a range of 4.2% to 30% reduction in LPT births when comparing conservative versus best-case scenarios for application of new PPROM management guidelines.
